description: This PHP source file defines the class `testPlanUrgency` which extends the `testplan` class. It provides functionality to set and get the urgency level of test cases within a test plan, including setting urgency for individual test cases and test suites, and retrieving urgency data with various filters. The file contains methods that interact with the database to perform updates and queries related to test case urgencies in the context of the TestLink testing management system.

classes.name: testPlanUrgency
classes.description: A class that extends `testplan` to add methods for managing test case urgency levels within test plans, including setting urgency for individual test cases and suites, and retrieving urgency data.

methods.name: setTestUrgency
methods.description: Updates the urgency level for a specific test case version in a test plan based on provided test plan ID, test case ID, and urgency value.

methods.name: setSuiteUrgency
methods.description: Sets urgency for all test case versions directly under a specified test suite within a test plan by executing a SQL update query.

methods.name: getSuiteUrgency
methods.description: Retrieves urgency information for test cases within a specific test suite and test plan, with optional filters and options, returning detailed information including test case external IDs and priority calculations.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Calculates the priority of test cases within a test plan based on their urgency and importance, returning priority levels and detailed mappings depending on options.
